title: Malaysia's ex-PM Najib Razak arrives home in Kuala Lumpur to serve remainder of jail term under house arrest
paragraphs: Malaysia's ex-PM Najib Razak arrives home in Kuala Lumpur to serve remainder of jail term under house arrest
A convoy of vehicles was seen at around 9.30pm at Najib Razak's residence after he was released from Kajang Prison following the issuance of a new court order.

KUALA LUMPUR: Former Malaysian Prime Minister Najib Razak arrived at his home in Kuala Lumpur’s Taman Duta neighbourhood amid tight security on Tuesday (Nov 10) evening to serve the remainder of his SRC International prison sentence under house arrest.
